drums.tags: Funk-rock instrumental. A clean electric guitar plays a syncopated, percussive riff using 16th-note scratches and palm muting. The bass guitar performs a slap and pop technique, locking with the kick drum on the downbeat and syncopating on the offbeats. Drums consist of a tight, dry snare and a consistent kick pattern. The tempo is 105 BPM in 4/4 time. The arrangement features a rhythmic interplay between the percussive guitar strumming and the active bassline.
